Fixed the `CASE ... ELSE` reindentation bug.

Root cause: `Case.get_cases()` kept the `ELSE` branch attached to the preceding `WHEN` value instead of representing it as a separate case entry. This prevented the reindent filters from inserting a line break before `ELSE`.

Changed `get_cases()` to create a separate `(None, [])` entry when encountering `ELSE`. All targeted tests now pass: **247 passed, 2 skipped**.

final_text:
Fixed the `CASE ... ELSE` reindentation bug.

Root cause: `Case.get_cases()` kept the `ELSE` branch attached to the preceding `WHEN` value instead of representing it as a separate case entry. This prevented the reindent filters from inserting a line break before `ELSE`.

Changed `get_cases()` to create a separate `(None, [])` entry when encountering `ELSE`. All targeted tests now pass: **247 passed, 2 skipped**.
